anomalies.observed: On the FCC Peripherals sheet the PWM driver U2 (PCA9685PW) is annotated 'I2C address: 0x41' (address pin A0/U2.1 tied high), and its SCL/SDA (U2.26/U2.27) are wired to the same I2C2_SCL_FCC / I2C2_SDA_FCC bus as the INA219 U1 (U1.5/U1.6, annotated 'I2C address: 0x40').
anomalies.expected: The specification states the PWM/servo driver is 'NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40'. The intended address is 0x40, not 0x41.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40 | `FCCPeripherals.sch` note "PWM Driver"
FCC Peripherals sheet: U2 PCA9685PW ... 'I2C address: 0x41'; Power sheet: U1 INA219AIDCNR ... 'I2C address: 0x40', both on I2C2_SCL_FCC/I2C2_SDA_FCC

anomalies.impact: The FCC firmware, written for the specified 0x40 PWM driver, cannot address the servo driver at 0x41, so the PCA9685 servo outputs do not respond and servos/PWM outputs are dead. (Had the address been left at the specified 0x40 on this same I2C2 bus it would instead collide with the INA219, also 0x40 — the 0x41 setting avoids that collision but breaks the intended address.)

parsed.summary: All parts, rails, crystals, EEPROMs and the documented barometer RESET/INT mix-up match the specification, but the PCA9685 PWM driver is configured at I2C address 0x41 (note + A0 pin) on the same I2C2 bus as the 0x40 INA219, deviating from the specified 0x40 and preventing the FCC from talking to the servo driver.
